lines.en: My spiral shell turns and I swim forward
I vent my shell and rise slowly
I glide along just above the seabed
My tentacles stretch and pull through the water
My ammonite shell parts the water
I tilt sideways around the reef
Ripples spread out from my shell
I wave my tentacles one segment at a time
I push myself along with a jet of water
My spiral pattern spins behind me
I travel along the shallows
Bubbles drift up from inside my shell
The Jurassic current carries me
I steer around the sand dunes
A soft body beating slowly through the sea
I press my shell low against the reef
My tentacles feel the way ahead
A spiral shadow cuts through the water
I hang quietly in the water column
I trim my buoyancy and hold still
My tentacles fold in and I stop
The ammonite hovers in place
I wait for small fish to come near
I sway gently with the moving water
My spiral shell stays perfectly still
I doze beside the reef
My tentacles slowly unfurl and close
I tuck myself into the shadow
My shell opening parts a little
I float and just listen to the water
A few bubbles escape my shell
I stay where I am and make no sound

lines.zh: 这个大家伙在水里做什么
lines.en: What is this big thing doing in the water
My tentacles reach toward you
You are blocking my current
My shell faces you and I am watching
Do you smell of fish
I slowly turn my shell toward you
You are much bigger than a fish
I stare at you and dare not come closer
You are above the water, I am below
I reach a tentacle out to test you
A seam split across my shell
It hurts, my tentacles pull back
Who hit my spiral shell
My soft body is wounded
My shell opening is numb from the blow
I rolled over before steadying myself
The reef cut my tentacles
I curl in my shell, shaking with pain
This wound is heavy for ten health
Fluid seeps from the crack
Is there fish, I smell something raw
Is that a little fish

lines.zh: 我的触手已经伸出去了
lines.en: My tentacles are already reaching out
Give me a bite of fish and I will follow
Fish-eater that I am, I cannot resist
My shell tilts toward it
I swim after that smell
You are hiding fish in your hand
I circle around the scent
Let me come closer and sniff
My shell knocks into you, so hard
Your nudge spins me around
You kicked my spiral shell
You pressed down on my tentacle
Shell this thin cracks on one bump.
I pull into my shell to hide
Your hit stirred up all my water
My shell edge scrapes your leg
Do not push, I will flip over
I am squeezed back half a block

lines.zh: 我的壳纹对着你的壳纹
lines.en: My shell ridges meet yours
Two ammonites hover side by side
We circle together in the sea
I lay a tentacle gently over yours
Our spiral shells touch
We turn slowly behind the reef
Your shell is a little smaller than mine
In the same sea we are a pair
Shell mouth to shell mouth, all quiet
We rise into the water together
I pick up scraps from the seabed
A fish bone curls into my grip
I cradle the food in my tentacles
What lies on the floor is mine now
I found a small shell
Can I eat this too
I stuff the fragment toward my mouth
I drag along what I gathered
I pick a pebble off the bottom
This much will keep me chewing
The smell of a school, I have it
That one is my prey
I swing my shell around and charge
One fish, just right
The target entered my waters
I have my eye on that little fish
My tentacles are ready
The prey is right ahead
I turn slowly toward it
It will not slip away this time
I trail the school the whole way
The prey still swims ahead
I keep my shell low and close in
Just a little closer, then I strike
The current hides my movement
That fish has not noticed me
I hold this distance
My tentacles are aimed at it
I hold until it turns this way
Catching it is only a matter of time
My tentacles snap around the prey
I bite down with my shell opening
I seize the fish in one move
My tentacle whips across
The prey thrashes against my shell
I drag it into my shell
That strike took all of me
I clamp onto its tail
The tentacles tighten, no escape
I ram it and bite again

lines.zh: 我从侏罗纪的海里浮出
lines.en: I rise from the Jurassic sea

lines.zh: 欧洲海底的老住户来了
lines.en: An old tenant of Europe's seabed arrives
My spiral shell breaks the surface first
I wake in these shallows

lines.zh: 只有十点生命，别小看我
lines.en: Only ten health, but do not underestimate me
I am woken from the rock layer
The ammonite swims once more
A shadow of the Jurassic returns
I settle down into this water

lines.zh: 我的族群比恐龙更古老
lines.en: My kind is older than the dinosaurs
This sea is mine to patrol now
Fire roasts my shell, it is so hot
My shell slammed into the reef and chipped

lines.zh: 水灌满壳腔，我闷得发昏
lines.en: Water floods my chambers and I go dizzy
The blast leaves my shell ringing
An arrow is stuck in my shell
Magic pierces straight through my shell
No fish to be found, I am starving weak

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and numbed me all over
I fell into a place with no water
